notes: Piano-roll drawing is now impossible to miss: an empty roll says exactly what to do (press an empty spot and drag — that draws a note), the cursor shows a crosshair over the grid, and the caption spells out the whole gesture set (draw, drag to move, stretch the right edge, tap to remove, right-click to sweep-erase). And the FL move you were reaching for: DOUBLE-TAP any clip in the Arrange view and it opens that track's piano roll or drum steps in the editor.
